title: Froster's QOL
description: Various Client-Sided QOL changes and Technical Additions in a single, easy to use bundle.
body:
### Tweakeroo
- Adds Optifine-style zoom with adjustable FOV.
- Adds the ability to offset a block placement by 1 block in any direction from the face.
- Adds the ability to specify a block's rotation reguardless of player position.
- Adds precise angle snapping. Useful for placing ice boats or other straight-line AFK travel.
- Adds a right-click spam button useful for certain farms where an AFK player is needed.
- Adds free-cam useful for just about everything.

### MiniHUD
- Adds a light-level overlay on relevant blocks. Red X means mobs can spawn reguardless of skylight. Yellow X means mobs can spawn at night. No X means mobs cannot regularly spawn.
- Adds a structure bounding-box visualizer to allow you to properly place and size farms.
- Adds the ability to render shapes through the config menu. Useful for spawning spheres.

### BetterF3
- Improves the F3 menu to be less terrible.

### Item Scroller
- Allows vastly better inventory/container management by utilizing the scroll wheel.

### Replay Mod
- Allows the user to record gameplay. Most keybinds are deactivated since pause menu operation exists. Feel free to override this if you use this mod often.

### Vanilla Tweaks Resource Pack
- Adds a variety of toggle-able resource packs to enhance UI, visibility, accessibility, etc.
- [Vanilla Tweaks Official Website](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)
- Credits: Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/

### Other
- Xaero's Minimap/Worldmap
- EMF/ETF
- 3D Skins
- AppleSkin
- Better Mount Hud
- Boat Item View
- Capes
- Chat Heads
- Do a Barrel Roll (disabled by default)
- Shulker and Durability Tooltips
- Held Item Tooltips
- Status Effect Bars
- Iris Shaders
- Jade
- Dynamic Lights
- Mod Menu
- No Chat Reports
- Many Additional Animations (including Not Enough Animations)
- ReplayMod
- Many performance/fix mods

### Keybinds
Many keybinds are unbound to reduce complexity. To open a mod's config, first pause, then go to mods, then click the mod's icon.

    Description              : Bind           : Mod
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    Zoom                     : C              : Tweakeroo
    Adjust Zoom Amount       : C+SCRL         : Tweakeroo
    Offset Block Placement   : LALT           : Tweakeroo
    Specific Block Rotation  : R              : Tweakeroo
    Angle Snap               : V              : Tweakeroo
    Fast Right Click         : B              : Tweakeroo
    Free Cam                 : N              : Tweakeroo
    Light/Structure Render   : H              : MiniHUD
    Structure Render         : G              : MiniHUD
    View Container Contents  : LSHFT          : MiniHUD
    MiniHUD Config           : H+C            : MiniHUD
    Drag to Transfer         : SHFT+LMB+Drag  : Item Scroller
    Transfer Item To/From    : SCRLUP/DN      : Item Scroller
    Transfer Stack To/From   : SHFT+SCRLUP/DN : Item Scroller
    Minimap Enlarge          : Z              : Xaero's Minimap
    Open Worldmap            : M              : Xaero's Worldmap
    Litematica Render        : L              : Litematica
    Litematica Operation     : CTRL+SCRL      : Litematica
    Litematica Menu          : END            : Litematica
    Litematica Execute Op.   : `(GRAVEACCENT) : Litematica
    Next/Prev. Struct. Layer : PGUP/PGDN      : Litematica
    Shader Enable/Disable    : K              : Iris
    Pause/Play Replay        : P              : ReplayMod

    Tip: From the MiniHUD Config, use the dropdown in the top-right to access other configs.
